newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CDL Investments sells Auckland property.
newsitem.headline: CDL Investments sells Auckland property.

text.p: CDL Investments on Wednesday said it had sold its Greenhithe, Auckland property for NZ$4.05 million, resulting in a profit of approximately $3.5 million.
CDL said the profit was the result of a pending favourable zoning change.

The sale, which follows the purchase of 68 hectares of land in Hamilton for $4.0 million, was a continuation of CDL's program of strategic acquisitions and the disposal of certain properties in a bid to reconfigure the company's property portfolio.
"The company has made an early start in the construction season and is well placed to meet its budgeted development program for the 1997 financial year," CDL said in a statement.
